compoundQuestion: Summarize how ADR 0007 classifies lifecycle work, handles trace ownership/route states, and separates evaluator recommendations from mutation and host authority.

facets.text: Which host-observed fields feed the lifecycle evaluator, and what is excluded from portable policy?
Which operations remain lightweight, become managed, or abstain to review, and when is Project Context requested?
What route action follows managed work with no trace, compatible trace without route, compatible route, or ambiguous/mismatched/unknown ownership?
What authority does the evaluator have, and which contracts/components retain trace identity, skill routing, execution, and I/O ownership?

labelBasis: Source-derived author review, not owner-gold, not sent to Jev.
